plan_name.description: Name of the 401(k) plan, as printed.

recordkeeper.description: Company administering the plan and issuing the statement, e.g. Voya.

employee_number.description: Employee number as printed, including leading zeros.

period_start_date.description: First day of the statement period, as YYYY-MM-DD.

period_end_date.description: Last day of the statement period, as YYYY-MM-DD.

account_value.description: Account value at the end of the period, in dollars.

activity_summary.description: The Your Total Account Value summary, exactly as printed.

opening_value.description: Opening value at the start of the period, in dollars.

other_credits.description: Other credits and payments, in dollars.

investment_gain_loss.description: Investment gain or loss, in dollars.

closing_value.description: Closing value at the end of the period, in dollars.

personal_investment_performance.description: Current period personal investment performance, as a percentage, e.g. 9.48.

holdings.description: Every fund in Your Asset Allocation & Balance By Fund.

fund_name.description: Fund name, joined into one line if it wraps.

asset_type.description: Asset type heading the fund sits under, e.g. Stock Funds or Employer Stock.

price.description: Unit or share price, in dollars.

contribution_rates.description: Every row of Your Current Payroll Contributions.

percent.description: Contribution rate as a percentage, e.g. 6.

estimated_monthly_income.description: Your Estimated Monthly Income in Retirement.

single_life_annuity.description: Single life annuity monthly payment, in dollars.

joint_survivor_annuity.description: Qualified joint and 100% survivor annuity monthly payment, in dollars.
